title.narrative: IDLO Investment Support Programme for the Least Developed Countries

description.narrative: The Investment Support Programme for the least developed countries (ISP/LDCs) will, upon request, provide timely technical and advisory support for investment-related negotiations and dispute settlement. The support will help LDCs attract and retain foreign direct investment (FDI). The support will be multidisciplinary, and designed as on-demand, targeted, quick response assistance.
